title: Android: handheld and Bluetooth controllers
summary: Android app now reads gamepad input from built-in handheld controls and Bluetooth devices. Before, gilrs had no Android backend and winit turned stick motion into touches and buttons into unknown keys. Now vendors patched winit 0.30.13 with Android support. Gamepad axes and buttons map to standard order matching Chrome on Android: A/B/X/Y, bumpers, analog triggers, both sticks, hat as d-pad. Also fixed on all platforms: gamepad Back button no longer goes back two menu levels when closing overlays.
details: Unit tests pass. Android 15 emulator with simulated gamepad: Start, A, B, Y, d-pad and left stick navigated menus, A started Free Ride, Start paused it, touch unaffected.
limitation: Not yet tested on physical handheld devices; analog trigger and stick hold during riding not exercised on emulator; no controller rumble on Android; touch HUD hints still show while using gamepad.
